security.withheld: Musevha uyu haukweretese tokeni yawo kuyambiro dzeDependabot, dzekuongorora kodhi nedzekuongorora zvakavanzika, nekuti mushanyi wese angadziona; nhamba imwe neimwe inobatanidza kuGitHub pachinzvimbo. Nzvimbo yakavanzika inogona kuseta {flag}.
security.refused: "hapana mvumo" zvinoreva kuti hapana tokeni, tokeni isina mvumo yekuverenga rudzi irworwo rweyambiro, kana kuti chimiro ichi chakadzimwa padura iroro.
security.capped: Tsime rinoratidza zviwanikwa {n} ringava nezvimwe; GitHub inonyora zvakasara.
token.title: 🔑 Tokeni yeGitHub
token.intro: GitHub inopindura zvikumbiro 60 paawa kukero isingatumire tokeni. Muti wese wemafork unoda zvinenge 32, saka pakushanya kwechipiri zvinopera. Tokeni inokwidza muganho kusvika ku5000 paawa.
token.step1: Vhura Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens, wozotsikirira Generate new token.
token.step2: Muridzi wezviwanikwa: akaundi yako. Kupera: chero zuva, muti haudi chinhu chinogara kwenguva refu.
token.step4: Siya mvumo imwe neimwe isina kubatwa. Metadata yeruzhinji yematura haidi kana imwe yadzo.
token.step5: Gadzira, wozokopa kukosha kwe{token}. GitHub inoiratidza kamwe chete.
token.classic: Tokeni yekare inoshandawo: gadzira imwe usina kusarudza nzvimbo. Nzvimbo isina chinhu inoverenga data yeruzhinji pachiyero chakasimbiswa.
token.stays: Inogara mubhurawuza iri pasi pekiyi {key} uye inoenda ku{host} chete. Haimbonyorwe mubhawa rekero, saka link yaunogovana inotakura maonero kwete chitupa. Bhatani riri pazasi penzvimbo yekunyora rinoidzima zvakare pamwe necache.
token.persistHow: Isa tokeni mufaira re{env} remusevha rinotakura peji iri, padivi pe{port}:
token.proxy: wozoitanga ne{make}. Mudziyo wobva wanyora chidimbu chenginx chinobatanidza musoro we{header} kuproxy ye{path}, saka bhurawuza rinodana kwaro pachako uye harimbowani tokeni. Nzvimbo iyi inonyangarika uye mushanyi wese anogovana bhajeti rimwe chete re5000 paawa.
fork.refused404: Hapana mitsetse yemapazi: {message}. 404 pano ingava bazi risipo kana nzira isingatakurwe neproxy yemusevha; mambure emafork ari pamusoro akakwana nenzira ipi neipi.
fork.refusedExhausted: GitHub yapera zvikumbiro paawa iyi, saka hapana mitsetse yemapazi yaigona kudhirowewa. Mambure emafork ari pamusoro akakwana. Wedzera tokeni muphaneru yesefa, kana dzima mitsetse yemapazi muphaneru yechimiro kuti ushandise bhajeti pamambure chete.
fork.refusedOther: GitHub yakapindura {status} kunhoroondo dzezvinyorwa, saka hapana mitsetse yemapazi yaigona kudhirowewa. Mambure emafork ari pamusoro akakwana.
fork.tagsOrphaned: Tegi harina zuva, saka rimwe nerimwe rakasara raizoda chikumbiro chisingashandiswe nechikamu chakasara cheawa.
fork.axisZoomed: {axis}, nguva yezvinyorwa nemategi zvakarodhwa. Mitsetse yemafork yekare kupfuura iyi inosundirwa kumucheto weruboshwe.
fork.axisWhole: {axis}. Vhura dura kuti udhirowe nzira dzezvinyorwa nekubatanidzwa kwadzo; mutsetse wobva wadzikira kunhoroondo iyoyo.

forks.leaves: hapana kana rimwe rawo rakaforkwa zvakare, saka aya ndiwo mambure ese.
forks.lazy: Dzvanya dura kuti uratidze mapazi aro pasi paro pamutsara mumwe chete wenguva.
forks.exhausted: GitHub yapera zvikumbiro paawa iyi. Wedzera tokeni muphaneru yesefa kuti ukwidze muganho kubva pa60 kusvika pa5000, kana dzoka kana awa yachinja.

bond.title: Matrikisi yehukama
bond.help: Mutsara kuenda kukoramu kumusoro, koramu kuenda kumutsara pazasi. Hukama hwe0 ipeji, 1 ndiko kupesana kwayo. Kupfuudza mbeva kunoyambuka vaviri muyero, kudzvanya kunozvikiya mupepuru kusvika pakudzvanya kunotevera. Kuverenga chete; mhanyisa infinito bond CLI kuti ugadzirise.
tests.status.never: gedhi rekusvetuka rakadzimwa mumhando dzese, saka muedzo uyu haumboshande
tests.status.skipped: gedhi rekusvetuka rakadzimwa pano; muedzo unoshanda mune imwe mhando
tests.status.always: hapana mhando inosarudza gedhi iri, saka muedzo haumbovi nechokwadi
tests.status.unknown: mhando iyi inosiya gedhi rakavhurika; imwe inorisarudza
tests.note.noSort: Hapana INFINITO_DISCOVERY_SORT: batanidza default.env yecheckout yecore (INFINITO_ENV_FILE) kuti uronge nekurongwa kwekuisa.

tests.note.ciSort.one: Kurongwa kweCI kwakabviswa pano kubva pamutsara {n} wakawanikwa, ne INFINITO_DISCOVERY_SORT. Kana zvakaenzana zita rebasa rinoshandiswa: kiyi yekupedzisira yespec iyoyo inonce inosarudzwa necore pakumhanya kwega kwega, isingagoni kudzokororwa nemunhu.
tests.note.ciSort.other: Kurongwa kweCI kwakabviswa pano kubva pamitsara {n} yakawanikwa, ne INFINITO_DISCOVERY_SORT. Kana zvakaenzana zita rebasa rinoshandiswa: kiyi yekupedzisira yespec iyoyo inonce inosarudzwa necore pakumhanya kwega kwega, isingagoni kudzokororwa nemunhu.
